start.title: Reti Vuote
start.text:
Alba sul lago.
Tutta la notte, e neanche un pesce.

curse_consequence.title: Resta
curse_consequence.text:
La rabbia non ti nutrirà.
Ricominciate.

leave_consequence.title: Indugia
leave_consequence.text:
Rimani vicino all'acqua.
Una voce sta arrivando.

teaching.title: La Voce di uno Sconosciuto
teaching.text:
La folla si stringe.
«Posso insegnare dalla tua barca?»

refuse_consequence.title: Dagli il Benvenuto
refuse_consequence.text:
La sua voce è gentile.
Dai quel poco che hai.

catch.title: [TODO:it] Cast the Nets
catch.text:
[TODO:it] "Cast into the deep," he says.
But the night gave nothing.

refuse_cast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust
refuse_cast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His word is not like other words.
Lower the nets.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Obey
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] There is nothing to lose.
Do as he asks.

miracle.title: [TODO:it] Nets Overflowing
miracle.text:
[TODO:it] Fish surge, the nets break.
You fall to your knees.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Humble Yourself
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The miracle is not yours.
Kneel before him.

call.title: [TODO:it] Follow Me
call.text:
[TODO:it] "Do not be afraid.
From now, you will fish for men."

hesitate_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Step Forward
hesitate_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Boats and nets will pass.
His call will not.

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Today
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Tomorrow is not promised.
Follow now.

follow.title: [TODO:it] A New Road
follow.text:
[TODO:it] Nets fall to the sand.
You walk into a new life.
